G01_DIRECT_NOVELTY.description: The metric must measure novelty itself, not interdisciplinarity, impact, disruption, quality, or exposure.

G02_NOVELTY_SIGNAL.description: Companion conventionality statistics and human labels are not counted as standalone computational novelty indicators.

G03_ARTICLE_LEVEL.description: The operationalization must return an article-level value.

G04_PEER_REVIEWED_FORMULA.description: At least one peer-reviewed original or paper-level application must support the formula family.

G05_REPRODUCIBLE_FORMULA.description: The formula, aggregation, direction, time boundary, and missing-value rule must be explicit.

G06_SOURCE_FIDELITY.description: Unverified approximations and project-defined summaries cannot become final indicators.

G07_PUBLICATION_TIME.description: The indicator must be computable at publication without later behavior.

G08_NO_FUTURE_INFORMATION.description: Any dependence on future citations, reuse, diffusion, or future-trained representations is excluded.

G09_AUDITED_LOCAL_DATA.description: All required inputs must already exist in the frozen local data boundary.

G10_NO_FATAL_VALIDITY_CONCERN.description: Mixed evidence is reported, but a demonstrated construct mismatch is fatal.

G11_OVERALL_COVERAGE.description: At least 70% of metric-eligible papers must receive a value.

G12_MINIMUM_DOMAIN_COVERAGE.description: Coverage must be at least 50% in every frozen broad domain.

G13_STABILITY_RHO.description: Reference-resampling rank stability must reach Spearman rho 0.90.

G14_STABILITY_ERROR.description: Median relative resampling error must not exceed 0.10.

G16_TOY_TEST.description: Hand-checkable toy formula tests must pass.
